_readme: Museum tiles factored into BAYS (step 1 of doc/plans/template_museum_unification.md). A bay is a maximal consecutively-repeating row block; museums are ordered [{bay, repeat}]. Deduplicated by content across all museums. Provenance: measured — every museum here recomposes BYTE-IDENTICAL to its tile in template_patterns.json, which is still the shipped truth. Regenerate with tools/extract_museum_bays.py after any tile change.
